verdict.rationale: Rootly shows strong, concrete two-way integration evidence for Slack, Microsoft Teams (declare/manage incidents, workflow actions to create channels), and Jira/Confluence (OAuth connector letting Rootly AI look up Jira issues and Confluence docs, workflow action reference including Jira). Workflows engine and API further support ticket filing and automation with these tools. However, the story also names Zoom and GitHub, and the evidence pack contains no mention of a Zoom integration or GitHub state-sync (only 'bridge-call transcripts' generically, not tied to Zoom specifically, and no GitHub ticketing/PR linkage documented). Missing for 10: explicit Zoom integration (calls/transcripts) documentation, explicit GitHub issue/PR bidirectional sync evidence, independent confirmation beyond vendor docs.
